why: A (corollary_7_3, MPolyfold.admitsScPartitionsOfUnity_of_hilbert, corollary_7_3_hypotheses_rn) requires for each chart's E0, besides a Hilbert norm (norm^2 = b(v,v), b continuous bilinear), the explicit hypothesis GodefroyTroyanskiWhitfieldZizlerStatement E0 (WCG + C^inf bump implies C^inf partitions of unity), the cited Theorem 5.14 [5.43]. B assumes only an atlas equivalent to the given one with Hilbert (parallelogram) norms on E0. B_to_A: the Hilbert charts of the structure form such an atlas (IsChart.compatible, MAtlas.equiv_iff), bilinear gives parallelogram, the M-polyfold conjunct goes through the trivial ep-groupoid, the GTWZ hypothesis is dropped; the satisfiability conjunct (corollary_7_3_hypotheses_rn) is proved directly, not from B. A_to_B fails only on GTWZ for (possibly non-separable) Hilbert E0: believed true (a deep theorem of Banach space geometry), absent from Mathlib and the project.
